message: config/deps.yaml does not match depcurfew.json: `minimumReleaseAgeExclude: ["*","@*/*"]` should be `minimumReleaseAgeExclude: []`
fix: Run depcurfew apply to bring config/deps.yaml back in line with depcurfew.json (depcurfew apply --dry-run shows the change first), or change depcurfew.json if the edit was intended
